questions.question: When a number is added to its next number and another such number that is four times its next number, the sum of these three numbers is 95. Find that number.
questions.solution:
Let the number be x

Next number = x + 1

**Given** that,

x + ( x + 1 ) + 4 ( x + 1 ) = 95

x + x + 1 + 4x + 4 = 95

6x + 5 = 95

6x = 90

x = 15

Hence, the required number is **"****15".**

questions.question: Which among the following are called the amphibians of the plant kingdom?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Bryophytes **are called amphibians of the plant kingdom.
 
• Even though these plants live in soil, and they require water for sexual reproduction.
 
• The bryophyte sperm, which is antherozoids is flagellate and requires water to swim into the eggs.
 
• The plant body is commonly differentiated to form the stem and leaf-like structures.
 
• However, there is no specialized tissue for the conduction of water and other substances from one part of the plant body to another.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

Pteridophytes

 
• **Pteridophytes **are commonly known as Ferns.
 
• The plant's body is differentiated into roots, stems, and leaves and has specialized tissue for the conduction of water and other substances from one part of the plant body to another.
 
• Some examples are marsilea, ferns, and horse-tails.

**Gymnosperms**

 
• The plants of this group **bear naked seeds** [ovules are not enclosed by any ovary wall] and are usually perennial, evergreen and woody.
 
• The seeds that develop post-fertilization are naked too.
 
• Examples are pines, such as deodar.

Liverworts 

 
• **Liverworts** are a group of non-vascular plants similar to mosses.
 
• They do not produce seeds, flowers, fruit or wood, and even lack vascular tissue.
 
• Instead of seeds, liverworts produce spores for reproduction.

**Formula used: **

Distance covered = Speed × Time taken

**Calculation: **

Let the speed of outward journey be ‘x’ km/h

Hence, the speed of return journey will be (x + 10) km/h

So, time taken in return journey = 300/(x + 10) hours

Time taken in outward journey = (300/x) hours
